'''Kai's Sword''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] dropped by [[Sword Ancient Kai]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Raisu Palace]].

==Stats ==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] -10 (while [[attacking]])
:Lengthens [[Crippling|Crippled]] duration on foes by 33%
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +7 (vs. [[elemental damage]])

==Skin==
This item shares the same [[skin]] as an [[Oni Blade]] [[dye]]d red.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*[[Katana]] from crafters [[Mathilde]] or [[Theodosus]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Crippling]] [[Sword Hilt]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sword Pommel]] [[of Warding]]
